versions.changelog:
No functional or content changes were made in this release.

- Version updated to 1.0.2 with no modifications to files or documentation content.
- All features, tokens, guidance, and links remain unchanged from the previous version.

- Added "Try Before You Install" section with a live demo link and details.
- Included a prominent "Live Demo" callout at the top of the document.
- Added brief promotional footer crediting InspiredHub.
- No major changes to the aesthetic or style token content.
- Removed the obsolete skill-card.md file.

- Initial release of the Claude Monet — Impressionism Master skill.
- Captures Monet’s signature techniques: broken brushwork, atmospheric haze, and chromatic vibration.
- Includes detailed aesthetic style and anti-style tokens based on direct analysis of 312 works.
- Provides practical rules for applying Monet’s style in writing, UI design, branding, and conversation.
- Features iconic exemplar works and a color palette drawn from Monet’s paintings.
- Clear evaluation criteria ensure authentic Monet-inspired outputs.
